lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 to 13 distinct white vertical stripes are visible; spacing is narrower and more regular across the ribcage, becoming wider and less defined toward the shoulder and rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three posterior-most stripes and the two anterior-most stripes are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank before reaching the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 4 distinct white spots is visible on the lateral posterior haunch, located superior to the hock and posterior to the vertical stripe series.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron on the bridge of the snout, a white patch on the throat, and distinct white horizontal bands on the upper sections of the limbs.
